map.肌效贴裁剪长度 = 按需分摊: Kinesiology tape cut length = apportioned as needed
map.测量长度（cm，肌腹/治疗区）: Measured length (cm, muscle belly / treatment area)
map.💡 总长度 = 测量长度 + 2 × 锚点。锚点（未裁剪端）用于固定，约等于贴布: 💡 Total length = measured length + 2 × anchor. The anchor (the uncut end) is used for fixation and is roughly equal to the tape width. Rounding the cut corners prevents curling.
map.⚠️ 贴布仅作辅助，急性损伤、皮肤破损、孕妇腹部慎用。建议由专业人员操作或先咨询: ⚠️ Taping is only an adjunct; use with caution for acute injuries, broken skin and the abdomen of pregnant women. Have it applied by a professional or consult a physician first.
map.测量时让目标肌群处于伸展位（如贴股四头肌时屈膝）: Measure with the target muscle stretched (e.g. bend the knee when taping the quadriceps)
map.形状：I 直条（稳定/支持）、Y 分支（绕过肌腹/肌腱）、X 四向（痛点减压）、: Shapes: I strip (stability/support), Y branch (around muscle belly/tendon), X four-way (pain-point decompression), fan strip (swelling reduction)
map.张力建议：肌腹 15–25%，肌腱/韧带 50–75%，锚点 0% 张力: Tension guidance: muscle belly 15-25%, tendon/ligament 50-75%, anchor 0% tension

map.膝踝关节贴扎前按部位与肢体围度算所需肌效贴长度，避免剪短反复拼接。: Before taping the knee and ankle, compute the required kinesiology-tape length from the site and limb circumference to avoid cutting too short and piecing it together.
map.肩部 Y 形贴扎约需 3–4 条各 15–20 cm，总长约 50–60 cm（: Shoulder Y-taping needs about 3-4 strips of 15-20 cm each, a total of about 50-60 cm (depending on body size).
